content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm new to [product_name] and would like to know if it's possible to communicate with it using BACnet. I see there are some communication modules available, but none specifically for BACnet. I have an application where [product_name] seems suitable, but I need a BACnet interface to connect to a BMS. Any advice would be helpful. Thank you.
Hi, You might want to consider using a converter for your situation. For example, products like those offered at [url] could provide KNX-BACnet connectivity as a solution. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user is looking for BACnet support with [product_name], noticing there is no native BACnet module available. This limitation creates a barrier for integrating [product_name] into building management systems that require BACnet communication. Community members have suggested using third-party protocol converters as a possible workaround.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is expecting [product_name] to either natively support BACnet or offer an officially endorsed solution for BACnet integration.
